ढ: ढ 1. ढ, the aspirate of the preceding letter; its use as an initial letter is very limited, and several of the words in which it occurs can scarcely be regarded as pure Sanskrit. —ढ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ढ्।
ढ 2. ढ, अस्, m. an imitative sound; a large drum; a dog's tail; a dog; a serpent; void of qualities (?).
ढक्क: ढक्क ढक्क, अस्, m., N. of a city or district (commonly ढाका or धक्क; the word is said also to signify a large sacred building); (आ), f. a large or double drum, a Ḍhāk; coveting; disappearance.
ढक्कन: ढक्कन ढक्कन, अस्, m., N. of a man; (also written टक्कन, ढक्कम, थक्कन।)
ढक्कारी: ढक्कारी ढक्कारी, f. an epithet of the god-dess Tāriṇī or Tārā, a Tāntrika form of Durgā.
ढङ्क: ढङ्क ढङ्क, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
ढाल: ढाल ढाल, अम्, n. a shield.
ढालिन्: ढालिन्, ई, m. a warrior armed with a shield, a shield-bearer.
ढुण्ढ्: ढुण्ढ् ढुण्ढ्, ढुण्ढति (properly a Sautra root not occurring in the Dhātu-pāṭha), to search, seek.
ढुण्ढि: ढुण्ढि, इस्, m. an epithet of Gaṇeśa. —ढुण्ढि-राज, अस्, m., N. of an author who was the father of Bāla-Kṛṣṇa and uncle of Śaṅkara-dīkṣita.
ढुण्ढित: ढुण्ढित, अस्, आ, अम्, sought, inquired.
ढेङ्क: ढेङ्क ढेङ्क, अस्, m. a kind of bird.
ढोल: ढोल ढोल, अस्, m. a large drum or tabor.
ढौक्: ढौक् ढौक्, cl. 1. A. ढौकते, डु-ढौके, ढौकिष्यते, अढौकिष्ट, ढौकितुम्, to go, move, approach: Caus. ढौ-कयति, -यितुम्, अडुढौकत्, to bring near, cause to approach, offer: Desid. डुढौकिषते: Intens. डोढौक्यते।
ढौकन: ढौकन, अम्, n. offering; a present, a bribe.
